title: Recovery of request fields
statement: For every Boolean word $x$ and streaming seam state $s$ with fresh cursor $f$, consumed length $c$, and phase $q$, form the round request by pairing the encoded seam word of $s$ with $x$. Its fresh, consumed, and phase fields are respectively $1^f$, $1^c$, and $1^q$, and its unread input is $x$ with its first $c$ bits dropped.
replaced:
Let $x$ be a binary word and $s$ a seam state with fresh cursor $f$, consumed
length $c$, and phase $q$, and let $w_s$ be the encoded seam word of $s$. On the
canonical round request $\mathrm{pair}(w_s, x)$, the fresh, consumed, phase, and
unread-input projections return exactly $1^f$, $1^c$, $1^q$, and the word $x$ with
its first $c$ bits dropped.
